name: Restate Cloud Free
free_limit: 100,000 durable actions per month on the vendor-hosted Free plan (per current pricing page); 1 GB Virtual Object storage, 1-day history retention, 10 actions/second throughput with 100 actions/second burst.
watch_out: Official pricing lists 100,000 monthly actions, but the vendor's Cloud overview still says 50,000; verify the live account allowance before production use. Each function invocation plus completion consumes two actions, with intermediate steps and larger payloads consuming additional actions. Free has no listed additional-action allowance; throughput is rate-limited. Paid tiers can bill overages. Commercial-use terms for the hosted Free plan are not explicitly confirmed.
